reasoning: 14.3.5（BT3.5）規定清單的標頭為目前所在區段的標題。與 COM-068（BT1.8，breadcrumb 顯示目前區段標題）的分工：breadcrumb 是導航路徑指示，本條指的是清單本身的標頭列，兩者位置不同、spec 分列兩條條文，故非重複；reasoning 在此點名以免 reviewer 誤判。只在單一層級讀取無法證明標頭隨區段變動，故步驟下鑽一層再比對。§8.5：catalog 建立狀態由 BT1.9／COM-070~073 擁有，屬其他 RD 的環境前提，不寫進 Pre-Condition（沿用 COM-057 的取捨）。 跨模組分工：COM 段已涵蓋 ch14 的 14.1.x／14.2.x／14.3／14.3.1／14.4.4（Browse Tab 的進入、導航、分類清單、方向盤轉場），本 parent 屬 14.3.2 以降的清單內容規則，兩者 section 不重疊，非重複。優先級：屬導航指示的顯示規格，訂 P2。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the current section title as the list header.

(Header after drilling one level down)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive containing at least three files with a valid audio format is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. The USB drive contains at least two artists, each with at least two tracks
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Artists category in the Categories Bank and read the header displayed above the Browse List
4. Press an artist entry in the Browse List and read the header displayed above the Browse List and the name of the artist pressed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The header above the Browse List shows the title of the Artists section
4. The header above the Browse List shows the name of the artist pressed in step 4 and no longer shows the title read in step 3
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
